scenes.image_prompt: Wide cinematic shot of a rain-soaked container yard at a northern Vietnamese port at night, stacked shipping containers under orange sodium lights, a narrow gap between containers sealed with police tape, a shape covered by a dark tarp in the distance, heavy rain streaks, wet concrete reflections, moody noir lighting.

Medium shot of a Vietnamese woman in her mid-thirties, slim, shoulder-length black hair tied back, thin glasses, light blouse under a transparent raincoat, standing frozen beside a parked motorbike in a wet container yard at night, flashlight beam on the ground, shocked expression, cold blue and orange light, cinematic noir style.

Close-up of a Vietnamese woman in her mid-thirties with thin glasses and a transparent raincoat, holding a mobile phone to her ear with trembling hands under a dripping warehouse awning, behind her a blurred figure in a dark jacket running through a port gate, cinematic noir lighting.
